episodes.title: E263 - North Korea’s Roots in Christianity w/ Jonathan Cheng
episodes.description: Danny and Derek speak with Jonathan Cheng, China bureau chief for The Wall Street Journal, about the Christian origins of North Korea's founding ideology and the subsequent personality cult. The discussion explores missionary Samuel Moffat's work in Pyongyang, the conversion of Kim Il-sung's family to Christianity, Christian nationalism during Japanese colonial rule, the turn toward socialism, Kim's postwar personality cult, and how Christianity informs the Kim family's rule today.
